description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #5: DELETE is a write-usage table reference too, but @sql now maps it to the specific ego.table.delete permission based on the statement's own kind, not ego.table.write. squ{{SQLTESTID}} holds write and (as of sql-15a) update, but not delete, so this must be denied. Before the fix this succeeded, because every DELETE was authorized as if it were an INSERT.
